_how: The dance menu for dance shots. Video models dance SLOWLY and off the beat: always ask for 'fast' and the BPM, keep the camera static, and let the edit speed the clip up (board shot "speed": 1.5; the song is about 136 BPM). Put the dance's prompt after 'Exactly as in the first frame, same framing and same woman:'. Never ask her to sing in a dance shot.

dances.label: 👊 Techno stomp (default)
dances.prompt: she dances hard Berlin warehouse techno on the spot to a fast pounding 136 BPM four-on-the-floor kick: stomping her feet on every beat, knees bent and pumping, shoulders hunched forward, head nodding hard on the beat, fists punching forward one after the other, her very long black hair whipping from side to side, relentless and focused, deadpan, eyes on the camera. Static camera.

dances.label: 🙌 Go-go arms
dances.prompt: she dances like a 1990s club go-go dancer, completely serious and deadpan, staring straight into the camera: feet planted, only her head and arms move, big fast sharp arm movements above her head and out to the sides on every beat at 136 BPM, hands framing her face, hair whipping with hard head flicks on every beat. Static camera.

dances.label: ⬆️ Jumps
dances.prompt: she dances hard techno locked to a fast pounding 136 BPM kick: big jumps on the beat, constant bouncing on her toes, knees pumping, one arm punching up in the air again and again, her long hair flying, eyes staring into the camera between jumps. Static camera.

dances.label: 🌀 Spins
dances.prompt: she breaks into a full-on dance like a dark Berlin techno club at peak time, locked to a fast 136 BPM kick: big sharp arm movements above her head and out to the sides, hands slicing the air, hips and shoulders pumping, she spins around on the spot twice with her hair flying, stomps on the kick, deadpan, eyes wide open finding the camera. Static camera.

dances.label: 🖤 Berghain head
dances.prompt: she dances like a regular at a Berlin techno club, completely serious, feet planted: only tight hypnotic head movements locked to a very fast 150 BPM kick, sharp head nods and small head shakes on every beat, shoulders moving slightly, arms low, staring into the camera. Static camera.

dances.label: 🤖 With the robots
dances.prompt: she dances hard techno in the middle, stomping on every beat, fists punching, her long hair whipping, and the chrome robots around her dance with her in perfect unison, stiff mechanical techno moves, heads snapping from side to side on the fast 136 BPM beat. Static camera.
